grail.definition:
n. the object of any prolonged endeavor
n. (legend) chalice used by Christ at the Last Supper
grail.translation: n. 长期以来梦寐以求的东西

grails.definition:
plural of grail
n. the object of any prolonged endeavor
n. (legend) chalice used by Christ at the Last Supper
grails.translation: (grail 的复数) n. 长期以来梦寐以求的东西

grain.definition:
n. a relatively small granular particle of a substance
n. foodstuff prepared from the starchy grains of cereal grasses
n. the side of leather from which the hair has been removed
n. a weight unit used for pearls or diamonds: 50 mg or 1/4 carat
grain.translation:
n. 谷粒, 颗粒, 谷类, 纹理, 本质
v. (使)成谷粒

grain alcohol.translation:
[化] 粮食乙醇; 粮食酒精(专指以粮食为原料)
[医] 酒精, 乙醇

grain coast.translation: 谷物海岸（非洲西部利比里亚的帕尔马斯角至塞拉利昂之间的海岸, 又称胡椒海岸）

grain of crystallization.translation: [化] 结晶中心; 晶核; 晶籽

grain size.translation: [化] 晶粒尺寸; 晶粒大小

grainal.translation: 钒钛铝铁合金(炼钢时加入, 用以改善钢的淬透性和韧性)

grained.definition:
v thoroughly work in
v paint (a surface) to make it look like stone or wood
v form into grains
v become granular
grained.translation: a. 有木纹的, 漆成花纹的, 去毛的

grainer.definition:
n. An infusion of pigeon's dung used by tanners to neutralize
   the effects of lime and give flexibility to skins; -- called also
   grains and bate.
n. A knife for taking the hair off skins.
n. One who paints in imitation of the grain of wood, marble,
   etc.; also, the brush or tool used in graining.
grainer.translation: n. 刮毛刀, 脱毛器, 鞣皮剂, 漆木纹/画木纹(者)

grainfield.definition: n. a field where grain is grown

grainger.definition: n. United States composer (born in Australia) who lived in London and collected English folk songs (1882-1961)

grainier.definition:
comparative of grainy
s composed of or covered with particles resembling meal in texture or consistency
grainier.translation: (grainy 的比较级) a. 有纹理的, 粒状的, 多粒的, 木纹状的

graininess.definition: n the quality of being composed of relatively large particles
graininess.translation:
n. 粒状的, 多粒的, 木纹状的
[医] 微粒状态(胶片乳膜不匀象)

graining.definition: n. a texture like that of wood
graining.translation:
n. 漆纹理, 漆成纹理的方法
[化] 析开

graining table.translation: [化] 搓花台; 搓纹台; 皮革搓纹台

grainless.translation: a. 没有谷粒的, 没有纹理的

grains.definition:
n a relatively small granular particle of a substance
n foodstuff prepared from the starchy grains of cereal grasses
n the side of leather from which the hair has been removed
n a weight unit used for pearls or diamonds: 50 mg or 1/4 carat

n a cereal grass
n the smallest possible unit of anything
n the direction, texture, or pattern of fibers found in wood or leather or stone or in a woven fabric
n the physical composition of something (especially with respect to the size and shape of the small constituents of a substance)
v thoroughly work in
v paint (a surface) to make it look like stone or wood
v form into grains
v become granular
grains.translation:
n. 双齿/多齿鱼叉
[化] 糟; 酒糟

grains kefir.translation: [医] 开菲小粒(含开菲酵母等的小粒,用以制开菲乳)

grainsick.translation: n. & adj.[兽医](牛)瘤胃积食(的)

grainy.definition: s composed of or covered with particles resembling meal in texture or consistency
grainy.translation: a. 有纹理的, 粒状的, 多粒的, 木纹状的

grainy club mushrooms.translation: [网络] 颗粒状的俱乐部蘑菇

graip.translation: n. <苏格兰>(铲粪或掘马铃薯等用的)三齿(或四齿)叉

graith.definition:
v. t. See Greith.
n. Furniture; apparatus or accouterments for work, traveling,
   war, etc.
